source.title: HEC Recognized Universities and Degree Awarding Institutions

tuitionNote: Public federal — fees moderate (~INR 3-4 lakh/year).
studentNotes: Niche specialist — fashion, textile, apparel design only. Not comprehensive. Established 1986 by Ministry of Textiles. Institute of National Importance under NIFT Act 2006. Multi-campus: 18 campuses including New Delhi (HQ), Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Gandhinagar, and more. India's leading fashion design institution. Member of International Foundation of Fashion Technology Institutes (IFFTI).
accreditationBody: Government of India (Institute of National Importance — Act of Parliament)

name: National Law School of India University (NLSIU), Bangalore
englishTestNote: Programs in English; CLAT (Common Law Admission Test) for BA LLB and LLM; NLSAT in some years
tuitionNote: Public — fees moderate-high for public (~INR 3 lakh/year for BA LLB). Substantial need-based aid.
studentNotes: Niche specialist — law and legal studies only. Not comprehensive. Founded 1987 as India's first National Law University. Karnataka National Law School of India University Act 1986. BCI-approved, UGC-recognized. Located in Bangalore. ~600 students; highly selective. NIRF #1 Law consistently. Alumni in Indian Supreme Court, Indian Foreign Service, top international law firms.
accreditationBody: University Grants Commission (UGC), Government of India

name: School of Planning and Architecture (SPA), New Delhi
englishTestNote: Programs in English; NATA or JEE Paper 2 for Bachelor of Architecture; CEED + portfolio for design programs
tuitionNote: Public federal — significantly subsidized fees.
studentNotes: Niche specialist — architecture, planning, built environment only. Not comprehensive. Founded 1941 as Department of Architecture in Delhi Polytechnic; SPA in 1959; deemed university 1979; Institute of National Importance under SPA Act 2014 (since January 2015). Located at Indraprastha Estate, New Delhi (twin campuses). ~1,350 students. Sister schools SPA Bhopal and SPA Vijayawada. India's premier architecture and planning institution.
accreditationBody: Government of India (Institute of National Importance — Act of Parliament)

name: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM Bangalore)
englishTestNote: Programs in English; CAT for MBA
tuitionNote: Public federal — fees similar to IIM Ahmedabad.
studentNotes: Niche specialist — management only. Not comprehensive. Founded 1973. NIRF #2 Management. Institute of National Importance under IIM Act 2017. Located in Bangalore on 100-acre campus. Globally recognized for finance, technology management, entrepreneurship. EQUIS-accredited.
accreditationBody: Government of India (Institute of National Importance — Act of Parliament)

name: CEPT University
englishTestNote: Programs in English; NATA or JEE Paper 2 for Bachelor of Architecture; portfolio + interview for postgraduate
tuitionNote: Private state university — fees moderate (~INR 2-3 lakh/year). Need-based aid.
studentNotes: Niche specialist — architecture, planning, design, built environment only. Not comprehensive. Founded 1962 as Centre for Environmental Planning and Technology by Ahmedabad Education Society. Deemed University 2005; State University under CEPT University Act 2005 (Gujarat). UGC-recognized. Located in Ahmedabad. ~2,000 students. NIRF top architecture school. Faculties: Architecture, Planning, Technology, Design, Management, Built Environment.
accreditationBody: University Grants Commission (UGC), Government of India

name: Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI), New Delhi
englishTestNote: Programs in English; ICAR AIEEA for postgraduate; ICAR-NET for PhD
tuitionNote: Public federal — heavily subsidized. Research stipends standard.
studentNotes: Niche specialist — agricultural sciences and research only. Not comprehensive. Founded 1905 in Pusa, Bihar; relocated to Delhi 1936. Deemed University under UGC Act 1956 (since 1958). Administered by ICAR. NIRF #1 Agriculture and Allied Universities (2024). Led research behind India's Green Revolution. Pusa campus 500 hectares west of New Delhi Railway Station. Sectoral accreditation by ICAR National Agricultural Education Accreditation Board (NAEAB). India's premier agricultural research institution.
accreditationBody: University Grants Commission (UGC), Government of India

name: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), Ludhiana
englishTestNote: Programs in English; PAU CET for undergraduate; ICAR AIEEA-PG for postgraduate
tuitionNote: Public state — significantly subsidized. ICAR scholarship schemes available.
studentNotes: Niche specialist — agricultural sciences only. Not comprehensive. Founded 1962 by Punjab Agricultural University Act 1961. State Agricultural University under Government of Punjab. UGC-recognized. ICAR-recognized through NAEAB. Located on 1,500-acre campus in Ludhiana, Punjab. NIRF top-ranked agricultural university. Pivotal role in India's Green Revolution by developing high-yielding wheat and rice varieties. Modeled on US land-grant university system.
accreditationBody: University Grants Commission (UGC), Government of India

name: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU), Coimbatore
englishTestNote: Programs in English; ICAR AIEEA-UG (10% national quota); state quota via TNEA; ICAR AIEEA-PG for postgraduate
tuitionNote: Public state — significantly subsidized. ICAR + state scholarship schemes available.
studentNotes: Niche specialist — agricultural sciences only. Not comprehensive. Founded 1971 by Tamil Nadu Agricultural University Act 1971. State Agricultural University under Government of Tamil Nadu. UGC-recognized. ICAR-accredited — FIRST State Agricultural University to receive ICAR NAEAB accreditation. Located on 1,200-acre main campus in Coimbatore. Strong in food technology, horticulture, agricultural engineering relevant for international food science and agritech pathways.
